Mini Text Policy
================

Document ID: mini-txt · Owner: People Operations · Effective 2026-01-01 · Version 2026.1
Topics: data_security

This document uses a plain-text layout. A line underlined with equals signs is the document title. A
line underlined with hyphens is a section. A line in capital letters on its own is a subsection.


Purpose and Scope
-----------------

This miniature document exercises the plain-text parsing path, whose heading convention owes nothing
to Markdown.


Device Security
---------------

Devices in this fixture are imaginary and are encrypted anyway.

FULL-DISK ENCRYPTION

Every imaginary laptop in this fixture has full-disk encryption enabled before it is issued.

SCREEN LOCK

An imaginary screen locks after five imaginary minutes.
